title: Central Chile: unit review
goal: Review the Central Valley, Valparaíso, Mistral and Neruda, 11 September 1973 and the recent votes, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: fronting, relative clauses with a preposition, stance adverbs, antes de que and después de que, si bien

items: I can review what I learned about central Chile, from the Central Valley to the constitutional votes.
I can use fronting, relative clauses with a preposition, stance adverbs, *antes de que* and *si bien*.
I can say what happened in the votes of 1988, 2020, 2022 and 2023.
I can put a place, a time or a quality first to stress it when I describe the Central Valley (review).
I can describe the places and ways of Valparaíso with *en la que*, *con el que* and other prepositions with *el que* (review).
I can show my attitude to a fact about the poets with stance adverbs such as *en realidad*, *en rigor* and *lamentablemente* (review).
I can put events in order with *antes de que* + subjunctive and *después de que* + indicative (review).
I can grant a point and say what matters more with *si bien* + indicative (review).
